en: Vintage tinted photograph of a large two‑storey school building on a hillside, with symmetrical wings, tall rectangular windows, and wooden siding. A picket fence runs along the street in the foreground, and there are steps and railings leading up to the entrance. Low hills or a wooded slope rise behind the building. At the bottom margin, printed in red, is a Romanian caption.
